subject: [PATCH 11/60] fork: check cached stack locality only on common memory nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted the original patch with a brief explanation of the change and its motivation. The patch is part of a larger series.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the try_release_thread_stack_to_cache() function to only check for stack locality on common memory nodes. It achieves this by changing the condition from node_state(nid, N_MEMORY) to node_state(nid, N_MEMORY_COMMON). This change allows CPUs on non-common memory nodes to cache stacks from other nodes.
